From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: SDK/Auth/Streaming quick tech summary (pre-call)

Morning — quick technical summary to surface blockers before the sync: 

1) SDK integration (mobile + server):
   - Current status: SDK v0.9 integrated with basic generate/chat APIs.
   - Blocker: auth handshake fails when using short-lived tokens issued via our test KMS (error 401 in token refresh flow). Root cause looks like clock skew + TTL handling in client stub.
   - Proposed owner: Karthik (backend) + Marissa (SDK)
   - ETA to patch: 48–72 hours after reproducer + unit test (if repro confirmed).

2) Streaming:
   - Symptom: reconnect after ~60s idle sometimes returns partial chunk and duplicates tokens in telemetry.
   - Likely cause: edge-case in our chunk reassembly when client sends a CANCEL followed by RESUME.
   - Temp mitigation: increase client keepalive and enable prefix caching on server for that route.
   - Owner: Marissa to prototype client-side fix; Karthik to validate server-side mitigation.

3) Tool calling / eval plan:
   - We should pin a minimal set of tool specs for the PO to exercise (search, calendar, invoice_lookup).
   - Owner for test harness: Marissa (create harness + example calls).

Attachments referenced: auth-flow-diagram.png (included in Evelyn's initial mail).

I'll bring these points to the sync and propose concrete task rows in the MAP.

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Redwood Inference
